name: gizza-ai/extract-rgba
summary: Export an image's raw per-pixel RGBA values as text, CSV, or JSON.

tool.description: Decode an image and export its raw per-pixel RGBA values (0-255 red, green, blue, alpha) as text, CSV, or JSON for inspection or scripting. Pixels are emitted in row-major order (left to right, top to bottom). Use `format` to choose text/csv/json and `max_pixels` to cap the output for large images. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

format.description: Output format for the per-pixel RGBA values: json (default; {width,height,pixels:[[r,g,b,a],...]}), text (one `r,g,b,a` line per pixel), or csv (`x,y,r,g,b,a` rows with a header). Pixels are row-major (left to right, top to bottom).

max_pixels.description: Maximum number of pixels to emit, capping huge images (0 = no cap, emit every pixel).
